```python
        password=DB_PASSWORD
    )

    db.autocommit = True
    cursor = db.cursor()

    print("Database connected successfully!")

except Exception as e:

    print("Database connection failed!")
    print("Error:", e)

    raise SystemExit

# ============================================================
# MQTT CONNECT
# ============================================================

def on_connect(client, userdata, flags, reason_code, properties):

    print()
    print("==========================================")
    print("CONNECTED TO MQTT BROKER")
    print("==========================================")

    print("Broker       :", MQTT_BROKER)
    print("Port         :", MQTT_PORT)
    print("Reason code  :", reason_code)

    # Subscribe to PDT
    client.subscribe("pdt", qos=0)

    # Subscribe to HDT
    client.subscribe("hdt", qos=0)

    print()
    print("Subscribed to:")
    print("  - pdt  → Electrical telemetry")
    print("  - hdt  → Device health telemetry")

    print()
    print("Collection class:", ASSET_CLASS)
    print("Waiting for LIVE LAPTOP CHARGER data...")
    print()

# ============================================================
# MQTT DISCONNECT
# ============================================================

def on_disconnect(client, userdata, disconnect_flags, reason_code, properties):

    print()
    print("MQTT disconnected.")
    print("Reason code:", reason_code)

# ============================================================
# MQTT MESSAGE
# ============================================================

def on_message(client, userdata, msg):

    try:

        # ====================================================
        # MQTT PAYLOAD → TEXT
        # ====================================================

        payload_text = msg.payload.decode(
            "utf-8",
            errors="replace"
        )

        print()
        print("MQTT MESSAGE RECEIVED")
        print("Topic:", msg.topic)

# ====================================================
        # JSON PARSE
        # ====================================================

        try:

            data = json.loads(payload_text)

        except json.JSONDecodeError:

            print("ERROR: Invalid JSON")
            print("Payload:", payload_text)

            return

# ====================================================
        # EXTRACT COMMON MIKOS STRUCTURE
        # ====================================================

        try:

            device = data["payload"]["data"][0]

            device_uid = device["device_uid"]

            device_data = device["device_data"][0]

        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as e:

            print("ERROR: Unexpected MQTT payload structure")
            print("Error:", e)

            return

# ====================================================
        # PDT → ELECTRICAL TELEMETRY
        # ====================================================

        if msg.topic == "pdt":

            print()
            print("------------------------------------------")
            print("PDT - ELECTRICAL TELEMETRY")
            print("------------------------------------------")

# ------------------------------------------------
            # Extract electrical values
            # ------------------------------------------------

            timestamp = device_data.get("timestamp")

            voltage = device_data.get("voltage")

            current = device_data.get("current")

            active_power = device_data.get("active_power")

            power_factor = device_data.get("power_factor")

            frequency = device_data.get("frequency")

            energy_consumption = device_data.get(
                "active_energy"
            )

            device_temperature = device_data.get(
                "temperature"
            )

# ------------------------------------------------
            # Minimum electrical validation
            # ------------------------------------------------

            if (
                voltage is None
                and current is None
                and active_power is None
            ):

                print("Skipped: No electrical telemetry")

                return

# =================================================
            # INSERT INTO LAPTOP TELEMETRY
            # =================================================

            cursor.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO laptop_telemetry
                (
                    received_at,
                    device_uid,
                    device_type,
                    voltage,
                    current,
                    active_power,
                    power_factor,
                    frequency,
                    energy_consumption,
                    device_temperature
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    COALESCE(%s::timestamptz, NOW()),
                    %s,
                    %s,
                    %s,
                    %s,
                    %s,
                    %s,
                    %s,
                    %s,
                    %s
                )
                """,
                (
                    timestamp,
                    device_uid,
                    ASSET_CLASS,
                    voltage,
                    current,
                    active_power,
                    power_factor,
                    frequency,
                    energy_consumption,
                    device_temperature
                )
            )

# =================================================
            # DISPLAY SAVED DATA
            # =================================================

            print()
            print("==========================================")
            print("LAPTOP CHARGER DATA SAVED")
            print("==========================================")

            print("Asset Class        :", ASSET_CLASS)
            print("Device UID         :", device_uid)
            print("Timestamp          :", timestamp)
            print("Voltage            :", voltage)
            print("Current            :", current)
            print("Active Power       :", active_power)
            print("Power Factor       :", power_factor)
            print("Frequency          :", frequency)
            print("Energy Consumption :", energy_consumption)
            print("Temperature        :", device_temperature)

            print("==========================================")

# ====================================================
        # HDT → DEVICE HEALTH
        # ====================================================

        elif msg.topic == "hdt":

            print()
            print("------------------------------------------")
            print("HDT - DEVICE HEALTH TELEMETRY")
            print("------------------------------------------")

            health_status = device_data.get(
                "device_health_status"
            )

            health_temperature = device_data.get(
                "device_temperature"
            )

            timestamp = device_data.get(
                "timestamp"
            )

print("Asset Class        :", ASSET_CLASS)
            print("Device UID         :", device_uid)
            print("Timestamp          :", timestamp)
            print("Device Health      :", health_status)
            print("Device Temperature :", health_temperature)

            print("------------------------------------------")

            # IMPORTANT:
            # HDT is currently only displayed.
            #
            # We are NOT inserting HDT into laptop_telemetry
            # because that table currently contains the

            #
            # Once the health-data storage design is finalized,
            # HDT can be persisted separately or linked to the
            # telemetry record.

# ====================================================
        # UNKNOWN TOPIC
        # ====================================================

        else:

            print("Ignored topic:", msg.topic)

# ========================================================
    # PAYLOAD STRUCTURE ERROR
    # ========================================================

    except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as e:

        print()
        print("INVALID MQTT STRUCTURE")
        print("Error:", e)

# ========================================================
    # DATABASE / PROCESSING ERROR
    # ========================================================

    except Exception as e:

        print()
        print("DATABASE / MQTT PROCESSING ERROR")
        print("Error:", e)

# ============================================================
# CREATE MQTT CLIENT
# ============================================================

client = mqtt.Client(
    mqtt.CallbackAPIVersion.VERSION2
)

# ============================================================
# CALLBACKS

client.on_connect = on_connect

client.on_message = on_message

client.on_disconnect = on_disconnect

try:

except Exception as e:
```

```python
        print("DATABASE / MQTT PROCESSING ERROR")
        print("Error:", e)

# ============================================================
# CREATE MQTT CLIENT
# ============================================================

client = mqtt.Client(
    mqtt.CallbackAPIVersion.VERSION2
)

# ============================================================
# CALLBACKS
# ============================================================

client.on_connect = on_connect

client.on_message = on_message

client.on_disconnect = on_disconnect

# ============================================================
# CONNECT TO MQTT BROKER
# ============================================================

print()
print("Connecting to MQTT broker...")

try:

    client.connect(
        MQTT_BROKER,
        MQTT_PORT,
        60
    )

except Exception as e:

    print("MQTT connection failed!")
    print("Error:", e)

    cursor.close()
    db.close()

    raise SystemExit

# ============================================================
# START LISTENER
# ============================================================

print()
print("==========================================")
print("LIVE MOBILE CHARGER COLLECTION STARTED")
print("==========================================")

print("PDT → Electrical telemetry → mobile_telemetry")
print("HDT → Health telemetry → live monitoring")

print()
print("Asset Class:", ASSET_CLASS)
print("Press CTRL + C to stop.")
print()

try:

    client.loop_forever()

except KeyboardInterrupt:

    print()
    print("==========================================")
    print("STOPPING MOBILE CHARGER COLLECTOR")
    print("==========================================")

finally:

    try:
        client.disconnect()
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        cursor.close()
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        db.close()
    except Exception:
        pass

    print()
    print("Database connection closed.")
    print("Mobile charger collector stopped.")
```
